newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schwarz Pharma sees 5pct hike in 97 gp sales.
newsitem.headline: Schwarz Pharma sees 5pct hike in 97 gp sales.

text.p: German pharmaceutical group Schwarz Pharma AG said on Tuesday that it expected a five percent increase in group sales in 1997, with earnings per share rising to 4.90 marks ($2.83) per share by the German DVFA analysts' method.
The group said in a regulatory statement that first-quarter 1997 pre-tax profits at the group were 51.2 million marks, a rise of 9.2 percent on the same period last year.
The group said that group sales in 1996 were up 17.5 percent at 1.195 billion marks, with net profit 103.8 million marks, a rise of 14.4 percent.
DVFA EPS in 1996 was 4.49 marks, up 20 percent.
